Reporting & Visualization/Portfolio & Pu.registryProposal: opaque-upstream-errors is framed around a broker relaying an upstream FAILURE. ascent has a real, deliberate case of the same underlying concern (deployment topology reaching an anonymous caller) on a SUCCESS path: leaderboard/page.tsx displays getDbMode() ('Aurora DSQL'/'PostgreSQL'/'embedded PGlite') to every anonymous visitor, while api/health/route.ts explicitly gates the identical value behind an internal-caller check with the comment 'shouldn't be handed to an anonymous caller'. The technique's current wording doesn't cover a topology label shown in a normal 200 response, so a project can pass this technique while being internally inconsistent about the same value. Consider naming 'success-path topology/backend-identity disclosure to an anonymous caller' as a named case alongside error relaying.
